positions.title: Product Architect, Software Developer, and Scalability Engineer
positions.description: I am a deeply experienced computer professional with the technical and communication skills to apply the latest technology to any organization’s bottom line, including machine learning and large language models. With more than 20 years of industry experience, I combine the hardcore technical expertise of an old-school sysadmin, the state-of-the-art practices of an AI-accelerated programmer, and the business pragmatism of a startup veteran.

positions.title: Senior Lead Cloud Engineer
positions.description: Writing code to increase the scalability and reliability of several large SaaS platforms.
